estimates.assumptions: Handful of sea salt estimated at ~15g as a modest seasoning amount for 4 duck legs; salt contributes negligible calories.
4 bay leaves; each dry bay leaf ~0.5g, total 2g edible mass (leaves only).
Handful of thyme estimated at ~5g fresh herb sprigs as modest seasoning; only leaves/needles considered edible.

4 duck legs; typical bone-in skin-on leg is ~300g each (edible meat+skin+fat portion after cooking, accounting for ~20-25% bone weight loss from raw ~380g total leg). Calorie density based on typical rendered duck leg confit values (high fat content).
100ml white wine; density ~0.99g/ml, so ~99g. Calories copied from known value (wine is fully consumed in cooking liquid).
